paragraph: A young Pacific walrus calf was found alone on a remote northern Alaska beach. Scavengers had been pressing in. He weighed about 220 pounds and was roughly five months old. SeaWorld Orlando took him in, one of only four US institutions able to provide this care. A team there now tends to him around the clock. They named him Annautaq. He is warm, fed, and watched over.
